title: Second opinion
description: I review your diagnosis or treatment plan from scratch, with access to any documents you have. At the end I explain what makes sense, what can be improved, and what should not be done.
highlights: Review with no conflict of interest
I compare costs and available options

items.name: Initial review
items.description: Bring your studies and I'll review the diagnosis with no conflict of interest. I'll tell you what makes sense and what should be questioned.

items.name: Second opinion + treatment plan
items.description: Review plus a written treatment plan with options, timeline, and reference prices so you can decide without pressure.

items.name: Written second opinion (no visit)
items.description: For patients outside Asunción. I review your records remotely and deliver a written second opinion report within 5 business days.

process: You bring prior studies: x-rays, treatment plans, clinical notes
Clinical exam and discussion of your case
I document findings in a written report
We review options together, with costs and timelines

faqs.a: X-rays (recent if possible), the original treatment plan or quote, any clinical notes, and your questions. The more information, the more precise the opinion.

faqs.q: Will you tell me if the other dentist was wrong?
faqs.a: If something doesn't add up, I tell you clearly. I won't defend a treatment plan just because another dentist proposed it — and I won't invent problems where there are none.

faqs.q: Is the written opinion accepted by other dentists?
faqs.a: Yes. The report is structured as a clinical document with findings, options, and recommendations. Patients share it with their regular dentist or use it to coordinate with a specialist.

faqs.q: Can I get a second opinion without visiting?
faqs.a: Yes. For patients outside Asunción, I offer a remote written opinion based on records you send. Same documentation, same thoroughness, delivered as a PDF.
